title: General.
officialText:
The use of above-deck thermal insulation shall be permitted provided such insulation is covered with an approved
roof covering and passes the tests of FM 4450 or UL 1256 when tested as an assembly.
Exceptions:
1. Foam plastic roof insulation shall conform to the material and installation requirements of Chapter 26.
2. Where a concrete roof deck is used and the above-deck thermal insulation is covered with an approved roof covering.
